Name: TC-05 — Event attendance instructions

Name: TC-01 — Public navigation links

Notes: Execution has not started; evidence pending.
Preconditions: Approved build/environment; synthetic event records include one with optional fields omitted.

Name: TC-04 — Event details and invalid links

Name: TC-07 — Influencer videos and profiles

Name: TC-13 — Anonymous event suggestion
